title: Subjective Assessment — SIN, Irritability & the 24-Hour Pattern

hook.en: The history decides how hard you may examine. Learn to judge Severity, Irritability and Nature before you touch the patient.
hook.ur: History hi decide karti hai ke aap kitna examine kar sakte hain. Patient ko touch karne se pehle Severity, Irritability aur Nature judge karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll take a focused history, rate a patient's SIN and use it to plan a safe, efficient physical examination.
goal.ur: End tak aap focused history le sakenge, patient ka SIN rate kar sakenge aur usi se safe aur efficient physical examination plan kar sakenge.

text.en: Experienced physios often have a working hypothesis **before** the physical examination starts. The secret is not magic — it's a structured subjective assessment. Its most practical output is **SIN**: **S**everity, **I**rritability and **N**ature.
text.ur: Experienced physios ke paas aksar physical examination shuru hone se **pehle** hi working hypothesis hoti hai. Raaz jadoo nahi — structured subjective assessment hai. Is ka sab se practical result **SIN** hai: **S**everity, **I**rritability aur **N**ature.

text.en:
**Severity** — how intense the symptoms are and how much they stop the person doing things.
**Irritability** — how *little* activity provokes symptoms, how *bad* they get, and how *long* they take to settle.
**Nature** — what kind of problem this is: the likely diagnosis, pain mechanism, stage of healing, red or yellow flags.
text.ur:
**Severity** — symptoms kitne shadeed hain aur insaan ko kaamon se kitna rokte hain.
**Irritability** — *kitni kam* activity se symptoms bharakte hain, *kitne zyada* hote hain, aur settle hone mein *kitna* waqt lagta hai.
**Nature** — yeh kis qism ka problem hai: likely diagnosis, pain mechanism, healing ka stage, red ya yellow flags.

simpler.en: How bad is it, how easily does it flare and how long does the flare last, and what is it?
simpler.ur: Kitna bura hai, kitni asaani se bharakta hai aur kitni dair rehta hai, aur yeh hai kya?

text.en: Irritability is like a sleeping dog. A calm dog lets you walk past, even pat it. An irritable dog wakes at the smallest noise and takes an hour to settle. You don't examine both dogs the same way.
text.ur: Irritability soye hue kuttay ki tarah hai. Calm kutta aap ko paas se guzarne deta hai, hath bhi lagane deta hai. Irritable kutta zara si awaaz par jaag jata hai aur settle hone mein ghanta lagata hai. Dono ko aap ek tarah examine nahi karte.

title.ur: Teen sawal jo irritability naapte hain

steps.title: What brings it on?
steps.detail: How much activity provokes the symptoms — 2 minutes of sitting, or a 10 km run?

steps.title: How bad does it get?
steps.detail: Intensity at its worst, e.g. 8/10, and does it stop the activity?

steps.title: How long to settle?
steps.detail: After stopping, does it ease in seconds, minutes, hours — or last until the next day?

beats.ur:
1. Kya cheez bharakati hai? — Kitni activity se symptoms aate hain: 2 minute baithna ya 10 km run?
2. Kitna bura hota hai? — Worst par intensity, maslan 8/10, aur kya activity rok deta hai?
3. Settle hone mein kitna waqt? — Rukne ke baad seconds, minutes, ghante — ya agle din tak rehta hai?

question.en: Mrs Khan says 5 minutes of standing brings on 8/10 back pain, and it takes 2–3 hours of lying down to settle. Her irritability is…
question.ur: Mrs Khan kehti hain ke 5 minute khare rehne se 8/10 back pain hota hai, aur settle hone mein 2–3 ghante letna parta hai. Un ki irritability…

text.en: Low
text.ur: Low

feedback.en: Little activity, high pain and a long settling time — that's the opposite of low.
feedback.ur: Kam activity, zyada dard aur lamba settling time — yeh low ka ulat hai.

text.en: High
text.ur: High

feedback.en: Yes. Easy to provoke, severe, slow to settle = highly irritable. Plan a short, gentle examination.
feedback.ur: Haan. Asaani se bharakta hai, shadeed hai, dair se settle hota hai = highly irritable. Chota aur gentle examination plan karein.

text.en: Can't tell without an MRI
text.ur: MRI ke baghair nahi bata sakte

feedback.en: Irritability comes from the history, not from imaging.
feedback.ur: Irritability history se aati hai, imaging se nahi.

text.en:
How SIN changes your examination:
**High irritability** — test only what you must, stop at the first onset of pain (P1), few repetitions, no overpressure; treat gently and re-test.
**Low irritability** — you may take movements to the end of range, add overpressure, repeated or combined movements and functional tests to reproduce the symptoms.
text.ur:
SIN aap ke examination ko kaise badalta hai:
**High irritability** — sirf zaroori tests, pain shuru hote hi (P1) ruk jayein, kam repetitions, overpressure nahi; gently treat karein aur re-test karein.
**Low irritability** — movements ko end of range tak le ja sakte hain, overpressure, repeated ya combined movements aur functional tests se symptoms reproduce kar sakte hain.

text.en:
Ask about the **24-hour pattern** — it often tells you the *nature*:
**Mechanical** pain changes with movement and position, and eases with rest.
**Inflammatory** pain is worse in the morning with stiffness lasting **more than about 30 minutes**, and eases with movement.
**Constant, unrelenting night pain** that no position eases is a warning sign — screen for serious pathology.
text.ur:
**24-hour pattern** zaroor poochein — yeh aksar *nature* batata hai:
**Mechanical** pain movement aur position se badalta hai, aur rest se kam hota hai.
**Inflammatory** pain subah zyada hota hai, stiffness **taqreeban 30 minute se zyada** rehti hai, aur movement se behtar hota hai.
**Constant, na rukne wala night pain** jo kisi position mein kam na ho — warning sign hai, serious pathology screen karein.

text.en: Knee aches after a long walk, better after resting
text.ur: Lambi walk ke baad knee mein dard, rest se behtar

why.ur: Load se juda aur rest se kam.

text.en: Back stiff for 90 minutes every morning, better once moving
text.ur: Har subah 90 minute back stiff, chalne phirne se behtar

why.en: Long morning stiffness eased by movement — think inflammatory (e.g. axial spondyloarthritis).
why.ur: Lambi morning stiffness jo movement se kam ho — inflammatory sochein (maslan axial spondyloarthritis).

text.en: Neck pain when looking up to hang curtains
text.ur: Parde lagane ke liye upar dekhne par neck pain

text.en: Hands swollen and stiff on waking, both sides
text.ur: Uthte waqt dono hath sooje aur stiff

why.en: Bilateral morning stiffness and swelling — screen for inflammatory arthritis and refer for tests.
why.ur: Dono taraf morning stiffness aur sujan — inflammatory arthritis screen karein aur tests ke liye refer karein.

text.en: **Special questions** belong in every subjective, not just when you're worried: general health, unexplained weight loss, history of cancer, fever, night pain, saddle anaesthesia or bladder/bowel change, progressive neurological symptoms, steroid use, recent trauma. One yes doesn't diagnose anything — but it changes your plan and may mean urgent referral.
text.ur: **Special questions** har subjective mein shamil hon, sirf pareshani ke waqt nahi: general health, be-wajah weight loss, cancer ki history, bukhar, night pain, saddle anaesthesia ya bladder/bowel mein tabdeeli, barhte neuro symptoms, steroid use, recent trauma. Ek "haan" diagnosis nahi karta — lekin plan badal deta hai aur urgent referral ka matlab ho sakta hai.

question.en: Which history finding should most change the NATURE in your SIN?
question.ur: SIN mein NATURE ko sab se zyada kaun si history finding badalni chahiye?

text.en: Pain worse after gardening
text.ur: Gardening ke baad dard zyada

text.en: Past breast cancer, new thoracic pain, weight loss
text.ur: Purana breast cancer, naya thoracic pain, weight loss

feedback.en: Yes — possible metastatic disease. The nature is now 'serious pathology until proven otherwise'; refer promptly.
feedback.ur: Haan — mumkin metastatic disease. Ab nature hai 'jab tak ghalat sabit na ho, serious pathology'; jaldi refer karein.

text.en: Pain 4/10 in the evening
text.ur: Shaam ko 4/10 dard

feedback.en: This describes severity and timing, not a change in nature.
feedback.ur: Yeh severity aur timing hai, nature ki tabdeeli nahi.

title.en: A complete subjective — what to ask

rows.en: Where exactly? Type of pain? Pins and needles or numbness?
rows.ur: Bilkul kahan? Dard ki qism? Sui chubhna ya sunn-pan?

rows.en: Maps structures and spots referred or nerve pain
rows.ur: Structures map karta hai, referred ya nerve pain pakarta hai

rows.en: How and when did it start? Getting better, worse or same?
rows.ur: Kaise aur kab shuru hua? Behtar, badtar ya wahi?

rows.en: Aggravating and easing factors, night and morning
rows.ur: Kya barhata aur kya kam karta hai, raat aur subah

rows.en: Sets examination vigour; suggests mechanical vs inflammatory
rows.ur: Examination ki shiddat tay karta hai; mechanical vs inflammatory

rows.en: Other conditions, medicines (anticoagulants, steroids), work, home, sport
rows.ur: Doosri bimariyan, dawaiyan (anticoagulants, steroids), kaam, ghar, sport

rows.en: Safety and the context of recovery
What do you want to get back to? What do you think is wrong?
rows.ur: Aap kya dobara karna chahte hain? Aap ke khayal mein kya masla hai?

rows.en: Shared goals; spots fear and yellow flags
rows.ur: Shared goals; dar aur yellow flags pakarta hai

text.en: Common mistakes: rushing the subjective to 'get to the hands-on'; asking only about pain, not function and goals; forgetting to ask how long symptoms take to settle (so irritability can't be judged); and examining a highly irritable patient so thoroughly that they leave worse — and don't come back.
text.ur: Aam ghaltiyan: 'hands-on' tak jaldi pohanchne ke liye subjective jaldi khatam karna; sirf dard poochna, function aur goals nahi; yeh na poochna ke symptoms settle hone mein kitna waqt lagta hai (to irritability judge nahi hoti); aur highly irritable patient ko itna zyada examine karna ke woh badtar ho kar jaye — aur wapas na aaye.

question.en: A footballer's knee hurts only after 60 minutes of matches (4/10) and settles within 10 minutes. How should you examine?
question.ur: Footballer ki knee sirf 60 minute match ke baad dukhti hai (4/10) aur 10 minute mein settle ho jati hai. Kaise examine karein?

text.en: Gently, stopping at the first pain
text.ur: Gently, pehle dard par ruk kar

feedback.en: Too cautious — this is low irritability. You may not reproduce the problem at all.
feedback.ur: Bohat zyada ehtiyat — yeh low irritability hai. Shayad masla reproduce hi na ho.

text.en: Fully: end-range, overpressure, hopping and sport-specific tests
text.ur: Poora: end-range, overpressure, hopping aur sport-specific tests

feedback.en: Right — low irritability. You need high-load tests to find the problem.
feedback.ur: Sahi — low irritability. Masla dhoondhne ke liye high-load tests chahiye.

text.en: Don't examine — send for an MRI first
text.ur: Examine na karein — pehle MRI

feedback.en: Nothing in this history suggests imaging first.
feedback.ur: Is history mein pehle imaging ki koi wajah nahi.

question.en: Summarise SIN for: 'Sharp shoulder pain 7/10 when reaching overhead, gone within a minute of lowering the arm; no night pain; no other symptoms.'
question.ur: SIN summarise karein: 'Upar haath le jane par shoulder mein tez dard 7/10, haath neeche karne ke ek minute mein khatam; night pain nahi; koi aur symptom nahi.'

answer.en: Severity: moderate–high at its worst, but brief and limits only overhead tasks. Irritability: low — clear trigger and settles within a minute. Nature: likely mechanical, local shoulder problem (e.g. rotator cuff–related shoulder pain); no red flags. Examine fully, including reproducing the overhead movement.
answer.ur: Severity: worst par moderate–high, lekin mukhtasar aur sirf overhead kaam rokta hai. Irritability: low — wazeh trigger aur ek minute mein settle. Nature: shayad mechanical, local shoulder problem (maslan rotator cuff–related shoulder pain); red flags nahi. Poora examine karein, overhead movement reproduce karne samait.

text.en: **SIN** = how bad, how easily, what kind. High SIN → few tests, stop at P1. Low SIN → load it up to find it.
text.ur: **SIN** = kitna bura, kitni asaani se, kis qism ka. High SIN → kam tests, P1 par rukein. Low SIN → load barhayein taake masla mile.

summary.en: Severity, Irritability and Nature (SIN) come from the history and set how vigorously you examine.
summary.ur: Severity, Irritability aur Nature (SIN) history se aate hain aur tay karte hain ke kitni shiddat se examine karna hai.

summary.en: Irritability = how little activity provokes symptoms, how bad they get and how long they take to settle.
summary.ur: Irritability = kitni kam activity symptoms laati hai, kitne bure hote hain aur settle hone mein kitna waqt.

summary.en: The 24-hour pattern and special questions reveal the nature — mechanical, inflammatory or serious.
summary.ur: 24-hour pattern aur special questions nature batate hain — mechanical, inflammatory ya serious.

back.en: How little activity provokes it, how severe it gets, how long it takes to settle.
back.ur: Kitni kam activity se bharakta hai, kitna shadeed hota hai, settle hone mein kitna waqt.

front.ur: Kitni morning stiffness inflammatory pain ki taraf ishara karti hai?

back.en: More than about 30 minutes, easing with movement.
back.ur: Taqreeban 30 minute se zyada, movement se behtar.

front.en: How do you examine a highly irritable patient?
front.ur: Highly irritable patient ko kaise examine karein?

back.en: Only essential tests, stop at first pain (P1), few repetitions, no overpressure; re-test after gentle treatment.
back.ur: Sirf zaroori tests, pehle dard (P1) par rukein, kam repetitions, overpressure nahi; gentle treatment ke baad re-test.

back.en: Any four of: history of cancer, unexplained weight loss, fever, unrelenting night pain, saddle anaesthesia/bladder or bowel change, progressive neuro deficit, major trauma, long-term steroids.
back.ur: Koi bhi chaar: cancer history, be-wajah weight loss, bukhar, na rukne wala night pain, saddle anaesthesia/bladder ya bowel change, barhta neuro deficit, bara trauma, lambe arse tak steroids.

note.en: Practise history taking on a 3D patient and get scored.
note.ur: 3D patient par history lena practise karein aur score payein.
